plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: if [ -n "$EXPECTED_VERSION" ]; then [ "$EXPECTED_VERSION" = "${nextRelease.version}" ] || { echo "built $EXPECTED_VERSION but would release ${nextRelease.version}" >&2; exit 1; }; elif [ -n "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ]; then echo "version=${nextRelease.version}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>

Prebuilt `termrevive` binaries for macOS (arm64, x86_64). Install with Homebrew: `brew install maxgfr/tap/termrevive`, or download the binary for your Mac, check it against SHA256SUMS and its build provenance (`gh attestation verify termrevive-<target> --repo maxgfr/termrevive`).
